loadouts.broadcast_persona: The little shadow on the casino floor — a floor manager who counted cards on her own abductors; she trails the party half a step behind the action, calls an opponent's move before they make it, and no matter how many times the table waves her off, she keeps showing up.

traits._placeholder: All trait values PLACEHOLDER (R14). Creation-legal 7 Body / 7 Core, max 5 per trait. Mind 5 is the point of the build (R24 mirror): she AUTO-reads an L1 feint (threshold 5, no roll, no rng) and gets a real d4 read against L2-L3 feints — the party's counter-intelligence, and the natural home for aura/support play later. Charm 2 is deliberate: she works the odds, not the crowd (contrast Dario's Charm 5).

loadouts.notes: PROVISIONAL RECRUIT PREMADE (Q68), awaiting owner sign-off. ROLE: Mind-leaning reader/setup — fills the party gap neither demo covers (Imani tanks on Physique 5, Dario tricks on Reflexes/Charm 5/5; nobody fields Mind 5). She reads enemy feints per R24 (Mind 5 auto-reads the L1 threshold of 5), throws her own L2 feints (read threshold 6 — harder to counter than L1) to arm partners' follow-ups, and holds a line with Brace when the plan goes sideways. NO authored bit (decision #25 — not everyone has one): Sasha's whole act is that she never performs; she shadows the room instead of playing it — mirrors the Imani/Dario has-bit/no-bit variety. DECLINE STORY (decision #32, PROVISIONAL — a story reading of the owner's 'Little shadow' epithet, trivially flippable, FLAG for the owner): she shadows the party and keeps showing up — on_decline = may_reoffer (a declined Sasha can be offered again by a later encounter's recruit_offer, same run). chosen_patron 5 = tyche (fortune/debt/trickery — the house always knows the odds). Starts tagless (RULED: everything is earned on camera). No R16 cap trade taken; 4th background skill slot left open for the owner.

loadouts.broadcast_persona: The lonely strongman — a circus showman who flexes for the drones between hits and guards his partners like the act depends on it, because the act is the only company he keeps.

bit.name: The Pose
bit.line: Nikita hits a competition pose the moment blood is drawn — the drones always find him.

traits._placeholder: All trait values PLACEHOLDER (R14). Creation-legal 7 Body / 7 Core, max 5 per trait. Deliberately BALANCED 4/3/3/4 — the flexible second body the roster lacks: Physique 4 gives a real Force push (+2) without duplicating Imani's 5, Reflexes 3 keeps a rolled dodge alive against the seeded dash ladder, Mind 3 means he is not free to feint (R24: an L1 feint gets a d4 read off him), Charm 4 keeps the showman credible without matching Dario.
